dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent — I understand you've recently given birth and now have a fever with belly pain. How many days ago did you deliver, and was it a vaginal birth or cesarean?
I delivered my baby boy three days ago, and it was a vaginal delivery. It was quite a long labor, but we made it through!
Congratulations on your son. How high has your fever been, and does your vaginal discharge have an unusual or foul smell?
My fever has been around 101 degrees, I think. As for the discharge, I'm not really sure - it seems like normal postpartum bleeding to me, nothing that smells particularly bad or unusual.
Where exactly is the tenderness — low in your belly over the womb, or off to one side or the flank — and does it hurt or burn when you urinate?
The tenderness is low in my belly, right over my womb area. It doesn't burn when I urinate, but I have been going to the bathroom a lot more frequently than usual.

Thank you — that helps. During labor, how long were your waters broken before delivery, and did you have any internal exams, a fetal scalp monitor, or need any stitches or manual removal of the placenta?

My waters were broken for quite a while before delivery — I think it was several hours. I did have a lot of internal exams during the labor since it took so long, and yes, I needed some stitches afterward.

Any chills, foul-smelling lochia increasing, or breast pain, calf swelling, or cough? Let me also check your vitals and labs.
